common_signal: Equal-weight mean of all six dominance scores after centering and scaling each series with fixed 2000-2009 moments.

sequential_detector.decision_timing: The statistic incorporates month t only after its outcome is observed; a crossing in t can first activate updates for t+1.
sequential_detector.threshold_calibration: 95th percentile of the maximum 120-month CUSUM under a joint circular moving-block bootstrap of the centered development-period six-variate observations.

inference.joint_family: For the primary rolling60 switch: switched-vs-frozen and switched-vs-full for neural, ridge, and tree.

promotion_gate: The primary rolling switch must have positive improvement versus both frozen and full rolling for neural and tree, Holm-adjusted p<0.05 with a positive 95% interval for those four endpoints, and nonnegative point estimates versus both baselines for Ridge. Neural and tree primary improvements must remain positive under every leave-one-year-out calculation. Failure closes this detector without parameter revision and forbids access to 2020-2025 model outcomes.
scope: First locked internal promotion test of a causal common-break update switch. The 2010-2019 period has informed the broader research program and is not an untouched confirmation sample; it is used only to decide whether the fully locked rule merits one later-period test.
claim_boundary: Even a pass is internal promotion evidence, not independent confirmation. Only a separately executed 2020-2025 run with unchanged detector and economic gate can support an out-of-sample claim.
